title: Eclipse Witch Reflection
description: A hooded witch in a flowing black and purple dress stands on a reflective pool of water, holding a staff topped with a glowing blue crystal. Her perfect mirror reflection appears below alongside an inverted black eclipse with golden drips, framed by an ornate stone arch covered in flowers and hanging lanterns.
prompt: A mysterious hooded witch with long white hair wearing a layered black and lavender gown stands on the edge of a perfectly reflective pool, holding a tall ornate staff. Her reflection is visible in the water along with an inverted black sun eclipse dripping golden liquid. An ancient stone archway covered in pink roses and glowing lanterns frames a cosmic night sky filled with ravens, geometric symbols, and swirling nebulae. Colorful mushrooms and flowers grow along the water's edge in a dreamlike fantasy landscape.
